maddeler.e:
استحملا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْمَلَا (istaḥmalā) /is.taħ.ma.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
# اُسْتُحْمِلَا (ustuḥmilā) /us.tuħ.mi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
# اِسْتَحْمِلَا (istaḥmilā) /is.taħ.mi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
